properties.description:
`list_skills` carries a `shortcut` per skill — stated by the server, never derived by the reader — because eight skills answer to a word that is not their name. Every skill has one, including the unaliased majority, so "no alias" never has to be told apart from "nothing said".

`tools/check_command_surface.py` compares the surfaces that used to drift: three skill directories against each other, the command source against its copy, every skill against a command that reaches it, every command against a skill that exists, and every renamed command against `COMMAND_ALIASES`. Wired into CI.

⚠️ USER-SCOPE COMMANDS ARE A NOTE, NEVER A FAILURE. They live outside the repository, so CI cannot see them; claiming to have checked something invisible to the gate would be worse than silence. That is the half of the original defect this does not close.
properties.name: Every skill states the word a person types, and the copies of the surface are compared
